rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name + zip and accessed the right user/orders. However, it performed order-changing actions without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit customer confirmation, violating policy. It also selected the wrong replacement for the jigsaw: the user requested 500 pieces less than 1500 (i.e., 1000 pieces) with the same difficulty; the agent chose a 500-piece intermediate puzzle instead of an available 1000-piece intermediate option, and it didn’t confirm or disclose the price difference before proceeding. The final message claims compliance with the user’s request but does not match the actual change made. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
